# cloudtower Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider for a CloudTower with a single management endpoint.
# The server address is a bare host[:port]; the scheme attribute selects http
# or https (default http) for every configured server.
provider "cloudtower" {
  cloudtower_server = "tower.example.com"
  scheme            = "https"
  username          = "admin"
  password          = "password"
  user_source       = "LOCAL"
}

# For an HA CloudTower (4.9.0+, multiple management IPs in an active-passive
# deployment), configure every management endpoint of the cluster instead of
# cloudtower_server. The provider probes the endpoints to find the active node
# and fails over automatically when the active node switches.
#
# Endpoints addressed by bare IP typically carry self-signed certificates that
# cannot be verified; skip_tls_verify (env CLOUDTOWER_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY) disables
# TLS certificate verification. Use with caution.
#
# provider "cloudtower" {
#   cloudtower_servers = ["tower-a.example.com", "tower-b.example.com"]
#   scheme             = "https"
#   skip_tls_verify    = true
#   username           = "admin"
#   password           = "password"
#   user_source        = "LOCAL"
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String) The user password for CloudTower API operations.
- `user_source` (String) The source type of user
- `username` (String) The username for CloudTower API operations.

### Optional

- `cloudtower_server` (String) The CloudTower server address as a bare `host[:port]`, e.g. `tower.example.com`. For an HA CloudTower use `cloudtower_servers` instead.
- `cloudtower_servers` (List of String) The management endpoints of an HA CloudTower (4.9.0+, multiple management IPs in an active-passive deployment) as bare `host[:port]` addresses, e.g. `["tower-a.example.com", "tower-b.example.com"]`. The provider probes the endpoints to find the active node and fails over automatically when the active node switches. Conflicts with `cloudtower_server`.
- `scheme` (String) The URL scheme used to connect to CloudTower, either `http` or `https`. Defaults to `http`. Set to `https` (optionally together with `skip_tls_verify`) when the CloudTower endpoint serves TLS. Applies to every configured server.
- `skip_tls_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification when connecting to CloudTower over HTTPS. Useful for endpoints whose self-signed certificates cannot be verified, e.g. bare IP addresses. Use with caution: the connection is no longer protected against man-in-the-middle attacks.
